text: We haven't been to a Buca in probably 6 years, it was a snowy night last night and some warm Italian comfort food sounded good. It was a good thing I hopped on open table and made a reservation, when we got there the hostesses were very overwhelmed and turning away all walk ins. We did notice once they got two large parties seated they realized they had quite a few open tables and started taking walk ins again, felt bad for those they turned away just a few minutes earlier, giving them an hour plus wait time. Our server was awesome, Maria gave us great suggestions and was fast and friendly. We got the Baked Ziti, some meatballs, and garlic bread, all to share as is the Buca way. Great selections! The meatballs fell apart they were so tender and the Ziti hit the spot. Leftovers to take home, we were very happy! We definitely won't wait so long for our next visit!

Not just a good Italian restaurant and not just a sweet neighborhood restaurant - Luciano's is both.  

Close and warm and home, this is what you'll get here.  Oh, and great food too.  Last night we had the penne puttanesca and spaghetti with meat balls.  Perfect and delicious.  

Starter was their crispy calamari with a delicious dipping sauce and freshly toasted bread.  A Shirley temple for the niece and we were settled in for a perfect meal out.

Live music and a steady hum of friendly conversation.  I have to push the penne puttensca it was extra tasty and super sized.  Thanks to the staff for taking care of us.

Plant-based comfort food, buffalo cauliflower wings with a delish dipping sauce, and local kombucha from Circle Kombucha- yes, please! My go-to is the Chili Mac bowl with cornmeal tofu as the protein option or the Shepard's Plate with the same protein choice. But honestly, you can't go wrong. Even my non-vegan friends love this place (especially the cauliflower-big crowd pleaser). A must-try in Indy!
Love, love that it is close to home, great food and service. I can work from there when I bring my laptop. My breakfast go to.

Extensive research went into where we should have breakfast in Santa Barbara. This was one the top rated & so we made our drive up early one Sunday & popped into downtown for some brekkie. Being Sunday, it was quiet & there wasn't much traffic. Many streets were closed to through traffic to allow social distancing of pedestrian traffic.  Parking was found around the corner & upon arriving, there was naturally a line. It wasn't too long of a wait. Orders are placed at the counter & a number is given to you. You are free to find your own table. There is both indoor & outdoor seating & indoor was ok when we went in October, but I'd check to see what the current situation is. We sat outside, along the side of the building & it's all very pretty. The building has big windows that pretty much open up to the outdoors & views are lovely. Now onto our food!! I had a plate of French toast. Hubby had the breakfast burrito. Yes & yes to both. All the flavors & textures were there. Moistness (I know y'all hate that word but it's important with certain foods) was on point cause I've had many a dry French toast & this wasn't dry. No rubbery burrito here. Prices are about standard for cute boutique-y cafes of this sort. They also have these tempting looking pastries behind the glass at the counter. Try NOT to take one with you! 99.9% chance that scone will be going home with you. It probably won't make it that far.

They've been blowing up my Facebook feeds with their lobster rolls so decided one afternoon to place a to-go order for two lobster rolls. Simply amazing lobster rolls, good chunks of lobster meat. The price was reasonable. Really enjoyed my meal.

Such a disappointment!

We went there for brunch and everything we ordered was not good. The French toast was dry. The sourdough bread was way too thick so the inside was just plain and sour not sweet. We also got the omelette and it was also dry. The only thing that was alright was the filet mignon and eggs. The meat had a bit of flavor but the potatoes again were dry. Our over medium eggs were well done and had to be made over which was good the second time. But again you can't really mess up over medium eggs. 

The ladies room was filthy. 3 out of the 4 stalls were not flushing and full of paper. 

The drinks were great but this was the worst brunch I've had. I won't be back

You can tell they aren't fully done with the place, definitely needs some finishing touches. Hopefully a bar coming soon. The staff was friendly and helpful, the fried shrimp  was very good. Glad they came to Bellevue because it's definitely needed. I definitely will go back.

If you want a top of the line Breakfast Sandwich this is the place to be. Middlechild is slinging out one or two or three or four of the absolute best breakfast sandwiches in town.
The establishment has a great vibe and is very clean and comfortable. 
The staff is very friendly and professional and very courteous. 
The decor is modern and very inviting. 
I ordered the Herschel Walker it had a copious amount of eggs and short rib brisket and it was huge and delicious. 
The prices are very reasonable for the breakfast sandwiches. I can not wait to go back and sniff around to see what else they are offering. I really, really like this place. I would definitely recommend giving them a whirl for a very nice breakfast you will not be disappointed.

Awesome food, great drinks too, try their espresso martini!

Every meal has been awesome my wife agrees as well!!
One of the best restaurants in Tampa. Amazing food. Great drinks. Stellar staff. A must try.

We got breakfast sandwiches and omg! They were so good. The bread of course made in house. I don't think you can go wrong with any of their sandwiches. My son for their cream filled donuts and they were also super yummy!!

It's not as bad as McD****** but it's not great.

When I ordered at the drive-threw the guy said, "We'll make that fresh for you." I thought that was strange being this is 2021 and since those Christian Fundamentalist who hide political/religious rhetoric under their cups introduced me to fresh cut fries and a burger made to order TWENTY YEARS AGO fresh has become the standard. 

The veggies were fresh and bun good but fries tasted frozen and the meat was boring.

I'll be back if my choice is this and the red shoed clown. I might even go with the King over this.

It really does deserve two stars.
Was fairly empty when we went which was nice. They seemed to be disinfecting the games often and had hand sanitizing stations everywhere. My son thoroughly enjoyed himself.

I lived in Mexico for years and when I first moved to Florida I was not really impressed with the restaurants that added "authentic" to their name or on the menu. For the record, I've tried the wonderful Puerto Rican restaurants and Cuban places down here but I never had a plantain or even knew what one was when I called Chihuahua Mexico my home:-) I came across this place when I wasn't even expecting to! It looked like a little market so I thought I'd check it out. When I walked in and saw the the little restaurant area in the back, it felt like I was back home!!! This place has THE BEST, Authentic Mexican food and I kinda hate to share this info, let the secret out & bam can't get in the joint it's so packed...But I love love love the the enchiladas, the tacos, carnitas, you name it Don P V's makes it and it's damn delicious! Little hungover? I bet there's some menudo with you name on it on a Sunday morning! The tortas even remind me of being back in Chihuahua at my favorite little street vendors stand! The portions are big I always have it the next day there's so much. And they are open late which is a plus! And they deliver so I'm not worried 'bout the crowd! You're Welcome!!!

GET THE DRUNKEN SHRIMP! I will say it once more, GET THE DRUNKEN SHRIMP! So good! I also got the clam chowder, which had a great flavor, but could've been thicker & the peel and eat shrimp. The peel & eat shrimp were huge & you get a really nice size portion. Beers & wine only, no liquor. Small, hole in the wall place right on the water....great ambiance!

Even bar rescue could not save this turd...never....never..ever..will I be back. Warm beer. VERY slow service and bland food...rather eat at the gas station across the street...and believe me, I am being nice.

The decor is rad. However, the service is the worst I've ever experienced. After our first round of drinks our waitress disappeared for over 30 minutes, I had to approach the hostess stand to find out if her shift had ended or what. This was followed by a very confused look and a "....I'll go find out out." 15 minutes later a different waitress shows up saying ours had gone home for the evening. Okay moving on. At this point 4 more people had joined our table and had to get 2 rounds of drinks from the bar because we were waitress-less. (Side note there was only one bartender at 6 pm on Saturday when our friends attempted to order, later more showed up). Our food is dropped off by a runner, no sauces for our burger/fries, no offers for refills. Still no waitress. When the waitress Alexis does stop by she's curt and borderline rude. Instead of staying and having more drinks I've had it and ask for the check. Alexis comes back and has no idea what we ordered because she's not the original waitress, so we tell her and 2 couples check out and leave. We later find out from the rest of our group that after we left Alexis tried to approach them and claim that we had not paid for several items-that we had not ordered! 
All in all the idea is great but I will not be back until there are serious changes to the staff. There's other places in Tampa where you can get decent service. If I were you, I'd go there.

This place is a gold mine.  My husband and I are currently staying at the Cambria and have eaten here for breakfast and dinner twice now.  The MOST fabulous Cowboy Burger and Chicken Fried Steak we have ever had, just to name a few of our favorites!  Not only is the food incredible, the atmosphere is great and the staff is more than wonderful - super friendly and super accommodating!  I would highly recommend NashHouse!

Met a friend for dinner here. First of all, it took forever for a server to come to our table. Once they finally came we decided to just order everything at once because we knew it could be a while before they came back. I ordered the quinoa salad and she asked if I wanted to add chicken and I said yes (not realizing it was an extra $6) the salad was pretty decent but the chicken tasted so weird and I immediately got a stomach ache after eating and was sick all night after. When my friends food came out, the plate appeared unclean. Do not plan on coming back

It makes me incredibly sad to post this update. I understand it is a hot and miserable job to run the oven, but those kids HAVE TO WEAR their masks and they don't. Under their chin and under their nose does not count. 

We've been in to Longboards a number of times since all the Covid-19 changes - in fact my initial review was not long ago. We have spoken with management a number of times, but after three visits with the same managers running the floor, and staff are *still* not wearing their masks correctly, I am compelled to post this update.

As long as Covid restrictions are in place, and sadly maybe even after, we will not be giving Longboards our business.

Sad because we love the pizza and the people. But public health matters more.

[UPDATE]
I am upgrading my review to three stars for a number of reasons.

1 - Feedback from the business. Educating me as the consumer, counts for a lot in my book. I thank Jason for his reply and explanation. I'm still miffed that the on shift management neglected to point this out when we were there, but we all live and learn.

2 - We still love the food

3 - With the exception miscommunication, we have always enjoyed the staff.

This place is amazing.  We had a large party of 8 and even with the covid restrictions we felt super safe and comfortable while we ate. The service was outstanding and the food was absolutely delicious. Will definitely come again
Beer selection is great and seasonal changes often. Food is top notch and servers are always super friendly!!

My husband order a Buffalo Blue salad with balsamic vingerette and make my own for me.  When he  got the orders home, I had  two hairs in my  salad. They  were mixed in the salad    My husbands order was without the balsamic vingerette.  I will never eat there again.  I am completely grossed out. I  thoUght the workers had to wear coverings for their heads. I

So incredibly yummy! Highly recommend! In the heart of the gulch. The shrimp and crab dip was so good, we gotta another one! The tuna poke was delicious and refreshing. We sat outside on the patio and really enjoyed ourselves!

Best Breakfast in St. Pete

I've been here a handful of times and my experience has consistently been superb. 

Food:
I ordered the Chicken and waffles with a side of home fries. They're easily the best chicken and waffles I've had so far. The waffles were perfect, but the chicken made the experience more than excellent. The chicken was perfectly cooked, the crispy breading was different from what you normally and so much more crunchy. They way they prepared it was refreshing. When you think of most foods, usually there's a peak to how good they get, this passed that for me. The home fries were great too, just crispy enough. However, the chicken and waffles were so good, I was distracted from how good the home fries were. The good tastes as good as it looks in the pictures I've included.

Service: 
Another thing I love about this place is the service. I've never had an experience was anything less than great. They're very patient and knowledgeable of the menu. They're always attentive and friendly, no matter how packed it is. Our server Victoria (I hope I'm not putting the wrong name) was very good.

Other:
The ambience in the restaurant is great. It's always bright and clean. We've sat inside and outside on different occasions, both make for a great experience. The line was fast too. When I got there it was out the door, but we were sat in under 20 minutes. 

On the multiple occasions I've eaten here, I've always left with no complaints. I 100% recommend going here.
We came here with the family and it was all our first time at this location. The pizza and wings were amazing. Definitely recommend you try this place!!!

one of our favorite Thai restaurants in Tampa/Brandon area. We either order out or dine in here once a week. My favorite dish there is the Pineapple Fried Rice,  and my wife usually orders some kind of curry, either the red or green. Honestly,  I have never tried anything else other than the Pineapple fried rice because it's so good, I usually get it Hot, which is the perfect level of heat. My wife always loves her curries,  have never had a complaint about their food. Service can be a little slow sometimes,  but i can't blame them for that, especially when there are so many take out orders and dine ins, that usually is a good sign of a good restaurant. If u like great Thai good, go check this place out!

Very disappointed with my last visit I was there for the very first time for brunch and the experience was a disaster I got rotten chicken in my sandwich they did confirm it and apologized and also offered me a new plate that I wasn't able to eat it due to the disgusting experience I had with the rotten chicken. Off course I was charged for it.
Very disappointed

Since we had a COVID Christmas, our family was not able to come over.  We went to Sullivan's on Christmas Day.  Staff was amazing...especially since we had a 12 and 9 year old with us.  They took their time and explained the menu.  Drinks, food and dessert was amazing!!  My only issue was you could not get the special on the menu because it was a holiday.  Other than that...perfect meal and evening!

Edit: They recently changed their bread to be more tailored towards the cheesesteak and less so the hoagie. The hoagie, while still the best, is slightly less delicious and I have yet to try the cheesesteak again but will report back when I do. I talked to management about this and they were very catering to let me know they will look into bringing the old roll back for just the hoagie, good people.

Takeaways: Best hoagie I've ever had, slightly above average but large cheesesteak, pizza not my cup of tea

I am torn in this review. I had read many reviews that say this is the best cheesesteak in the city and others that say average. They are definitely slightly above average and large. The bread is delicious but not really cheesesteak type. The meat is really the downfall, it's pretty low quality, cheese is decent and the onions are okay; better meat and it could be very good.

BUT THEIR HOAGIES. OMMFG!!! I won't go anywhere else. My mouth is watering. The bread compliments a hoagie way better than a cheesesteak. These things are MASSIVE. The meat is heavily packed, very quality and stacked. Veggies are as fresh as they come. This made hoagies my favorite thing to eat.

I personally don't like their pizza but I have friends that do. It's a large slice, very cheese heavy, soft on the sauce and the dough is very hard and kinda flavorless. Big and cheesy.

I would give 6/5 stars for the hoagie but the place has steaks in the name and steaks are a little better than average. Whi

Being a Filipina college student in a city that doesn't boast many Filipino restaurants, I am thankful for this food cart that stands along 33rd Street just minutes away from my classes. Every time I walk past the cart on the way to class, clouds of smoke from the grill hit my face and trigger my cravings for Filipino food. Even a lot of my friends have commented on how good the food smells when they walk past!

For $5 or $6 dollars (cash/venmo), you get a Filipino bbq chicken/pork/combo rice platter topped with onions and hot sauce (if that's your thing- highly recommend)! The food on first taste is surprisingly light, and the portion size is perfect, creating for a meal that's filling but won't leave you in a food coma (like most Filipino meals). Filipino bbq tends to be on the sweeter side, and what I like about the bbq here is the additional vinegary factor, since Filipinos love their vinegar! I found the hot sauce to be an interesting addition to the dish since Filipino food is traditionally mild, but it adds a great tangy heat to the grilled meat. While this was not exactly the kind of food I had growing up at home, the Filipino flavor is definitely there, and it is enough to fulfill my constant Filipino food cravings. All of the food is made to order, so there will be a bit of a wait to get your food, and the time may add up if the line gets long. If you're in a rush, I recommend trying to avoid peak lunch times.

Jay, the grillmaster and owner of Mommy Telly's, is alw

The Pork tamalli and cheese enchilada was so old and gross. The tamalli was dried to the husk and the meet was prettified and the enchilada was pathetic. It's astonishing that the employees who are all Mexican thought "yeah that looks good" believe me non of them would have eaten this plate. So gross! I will never go back or recommend.
So disappointed and angry!
Angela

Just placed my first order here for delivery and WOW, I am so impressed. Not only did they get my order to me in about ten minutes (they list 40 minutes as an expected time frame), the food was great! It tasted fresh, was still far too hot to eat immediately, and there were no mistakes unlike food delivery apps. Prices were a bit high but the quality justifies it for sure. The guy who delivered my food was professional and wearing a mask. Will certainly order from here again!
Def go eat here!. Had the bone marrow appetizer, it was insane and the filet was cooked perfectly . Mussels were also really bomb. Good drinks(full bar) , good service and really good food.

Go big or go home! The menu is enormous and so are the portions
With modest prices you definitely get your money's worth
Believe it or not this is my first visit to the Dill. Everybody seems to know about it, I've been invited to business events at this location and finally today I stopped in. 
First a peak in their Bakery and oh man I was in love. So many awesome choices. But all that went through my mind was, I'm afraid to ask the prices these look like $10 desserts LoL, then I thought with such an amazing large variety they can't possibly sell through this daily so how fresh is it? And then in the bubble above my head I could see the calories racking up and that was the end of that. Next time!
But I digress
Onward to the food..........
The restaurant had a nice vibe and the playlist was on point 
The service a little slow for how busy they were but it was done with a smile  
The menu was so enormous!! It was hard to choose.  Really hard. With that many Items you know most of this isn't fresh which was a little disappointing. Like the cheesecake that comes free with a drink order. Frozen from some Cisco type food company not from the bakery next door. I know some of it is freshly made but which items I don't know.
While perusing the menu a fresh roll basket came out and they were really good 
I finally decIded on the Black Friday whIch is Thanksgiving on a sandwich with sweet potato waffle fries sprinkled with powdered sugar and accompanied with a marshmallow fluff dip. Oh

From the last time we were there (1 year ago) I think they definirlo improved on their quality of food.. great selection everything we had was tasty .. I was a little disappointed with the crab legs it seemed like they were a tad bit undercooked but other than that sushi was fresh and so was all the other food

Favorite place to get a Po Boy in New Orleans. I make the trip multiple times each year, and I always make sure to head to Verti Marte at least once, most likely twice, every time I'm in the city. Random, but their grilled cheese is great too. Their bread is the best. Be mindful that they accept cash only.

Incredible! This place is tiny, especially now during covid. It only has 4-5 spots to sit indoors and 2 tables with a fire pit in the middle for outside. The service and ambience is excellent. I love the happy hour drink specials, it made it that much more worth it and affordable. But the real star of the show is the short rib! WOW! No surprise of course as their meat is coming from the restaurant next-door: MEAT. Pro tip: their short rib gets bigger in the winter!

I'm was a frequenter at El Vez- went approximately 3 times a week. Food and service have been positive for as long as I can remember. However the most recent time I found a long piece of hair in nachos. I order the nachos all the time and I understand it happens. 18 inch length hair- tried to pull it out but wouldn't end. Rapunzel- beautiful soul and hair, but not in my nachos.  Server was very understanding and did her part to replace it. However when the bill came the nachos were still on there! Unacceptable. Expected more and at least take that off the bill. This rating is not a reflection of service or food but rather poor management who doesn't care to accommodate their clientele.
This is our go-to spot for wings & drinks!  As always, we had great food and great service at lunch today.  Our server Leah went above and beyond today to provide recommendations & top-notch service.

So glad that I found this local restaurant. They have reasonable prices and a variety to choose from. I would highly suggest trying this place out and definitely order ahead. The only thing I do have a problem with is their health score. Having a health score of 60 out of 100 is concerning.

After a 5 day trip to Jamaica I was needing a fix of some authentic Jamaican cuisine and Jamaican Style Jerk did not disappoint. As soon as you walk in you can instantly smell a lovely aroma of barbecue and jerk meats being cooked. There are so many good options to choose from including the classics like Jerk Chicken, Oxtail, & Curry Goat. If you are wanting Saltfish and Ackee Saturday (when I went) is the only day they offer the iconic dish. After a few minutes of deliberating (as I mentioned lots of good options made it hard to choose just one) I decided to go with the Saltfish and Ackee which came with rice & beans, steamed cabbage, & fried plantains. I also got a Tropical Rhythm juice since that was one of my favorites from my recent trip (and would recommend you getting one too as they are very good and have some great flavors). The meal was divine, filling, and took me right back to Jamaica. Can't wait to come back!
My favorite Indian place in Philly by far in the 3 years that I have lived here. The staff is super friendly, the turn around is quick, and the food is delicious. Keep it up!

First time here -- came to Reno for Atlantis Friday night Buffet but thank you COVID-19, they were sold out. 

We ordered the Gold Bag with lobster and shrimp fried rice. 

Positives: the rice was DELICIOUS. So good, we ordered another!  There were a lot of shrimp in the Gold Bag, lobster as expected. The sauce was really good -- we had the "beginner" with garlic butter.  Good service, constant refills on our drinks, didn't check in so much as to bother. 

Negatives:  when the menu said "2 potatoes, 2 corn and 2 sausage" I expected that. What we got in our $75 gold bag was 2 2" pieces of corn, one red potato cut into 2 pieces and 2 slices, about 2" long, of sausage. They all tasted really good -- left us wanting more to cut up the richness of the sea food. For $75 -- remember the sea food is all fully in the shell, reducing the actual weight of what you eat (seafood is given by the pound) -- they should give whole corn (or at least a half??), a whole tiny red potato (or several since potatoes are dirt cheap) and whole sausages. 

Would I eat there again? Yes -- to try other menu items. Would I buy a Gold Bag again? No -- they skimped on the cheap ingredients and the shrimp was in the shell.

I'm so glad they  ow have a branch here in Tampa Bay! I don't have to wait till we're driving thru Gainesville to get my Sweet Buns fix  

You can't go wrong with anything in this place but I highly recommend the red bean bun (it looks so pretty too) their egg and lemon tarts are super
Tasty (especially warmed up) and the hotdog buns (I know it's odd for Americans lol) but I promise it's pretty tasty!  
Also unlike the Gainesville branch, this one serves hot meals for a reasonable price! I've tried their roast duck rice bowl and pork ones. Tasty and filling for the same price as a chick fil a meal.

Definitely great to see that Fitz's has expanded. It's been awhile since the one in South County has been opened, but I recently went and wanted to share my experience!

First, the place is definitely larger. However, I can't tell if the reason is because of the high ceilings or the amount of open space that makes the place look twice as big as the first location (in the Delmar Loop)!

Second, the waiter was great and attentive to the details! And the chefs in the back definitely prepared the meals to our table's liking!

What we got:
The River City Burger with everything on top (not pictured)
The Bourbon Burger with everything on top
The Bottler's Burger with everything on top and no cheese

The burgers were great, not drying! They were flavorful and the toppings were all great except for the very strong and overpowering onions. I had maybe a bite of the onion because I took it out of the burger. If you love more raw onions, then definitely put stick that sucker back in! haha

All the dishes came with your choice of side. We all had chosen the fries and we did not regret it!

None of us got the floats because we had gone much later in the night (around 8pm on a Tuesday). We have already had a majority of their floats at the other location. If it is your first time there, then it's worth a purchase!

Have never once written a yelp review so this is my first. Wow!! Okay so my wife took me here this past Saturday evening for my birthday, and wow! It didn't fail to live up to the hype. The music was amazing and so much fun to see live these songs we knew. 
The food was amazing, my wife and I ordered the chicken mozzarella sandwich and the caprese both so delicious. I NEED that ranch recipe it was the best I've ever tasted. (And I own a restaurant back home so I know) The food was far better than I had been thinking it would be. The drinks were local brews and all great beers. Great selection all around. Our waitress was amazing and so sweet to each of our needs. Thank you again nashville and blue bird cafe for the best birthday I've had in years. This is a fun and great night out, so happy to have been able to have come here.
This place has the best sandwiches I've ever had. I get the veggie and it's sooo good and flavorful and plentiful. A little on the pricey side for a sandwich but honestly so worth it.

Really tasty! Have had a stuffed burger and it was fantastic: perfectly fine and we'll filled.. ready great. I know I will eat many more.
However, th stuffed benieghs are incredible!!!!!
Have had the crawfish, roast beef, BBQ, steak and cheese bacon egg and cheese, steak egg and cheese. 
Every one if them beyond great.
Flower portions. I'm an average size guy and I have yet to eat more than one in a sitting. 
Since you get 2 in an order, I'm set for 2 lunches! Good deal.
You have to try it! Really!!

Today I went to pick up my order as I was opening the door I was greeted by the hostess, she was extremely friendly and she gave me my order and invited me to visit again! Its little interactions like that which really makes a difference in a customers experience, I definitely will visit again and recommend this location to all of my friends! Keep up the good work!
Really enjoyed the ribs, the brisket and the sausage. Liked that you can sample all of the sauces.
My favorite pizza spot! This is definitely my go to spot for pizza I highly recommend!

A very nice evening at Rattlesnake Club. We dined on the patio - which was the perfect temperature and quite comfortable. If I knew we were going to be their so long, I would have brought a pillow for the chair. We really lingered over our meal. 

First, our server - Krista (Christa, Crista?) gave great service and well researched recommendations. Many times you will ask a server about a dish and they have nothing to say - clearly hadn't tried the food. That's too bad. It's much easier to sell/recommend food that you know. 

We started with cocktails - the Rhubarb Negroni for him - the Margarita for me. The Marg was GREAT - but the Negroni was probably the best I ever had. It was incredibly well balanced. 

Apps included Burrata and the Firecracker Shrimp. The Burrata you can see in the picture came out on a large platter with incredible accompaniments. Roasted garlic, pickled veg, olives, perfectly toasted bread and arugula. Each bite was your own creation. The Shrimp - divine. Just that light crunch when you bit into them. I have tried to recreate this at home and have failed, miserably. 

Lamb and Ribeye were the mains. Lamb in a Chimichurri and mash, the Ribeye with perfectly done potatoes au gratin. Such a hard dish to get right - they got it right. 

A great bottle of 2016 Trefethen Double T Red rounded out the dinner. 

But - wait.. dessert? No really we shouldn't .. but we did. Peach bread pudding and a creme brulee. The bread pudding ruined me for all other bread pud

I've been to hawkers a handful of times and I have yet to have a bad experience. The food is always super quick and incredibly flavorful. Not only is it flavorful but it's very diverse flavors which I really appreciate, especially when we're ordering lots of small plates to share! The cocktails here are fun and tasty! And the environment is chic and trendy. Upon first impressions you may think this place is just an Instagram heaven but you would be so wrong because the food definitely lives up to all of the hype!

Make sure you get an order of Roti! It's prepared fresh, comes out piping hot and is the perfect addition to literally anything on the menu! 

I will always recommend  this place to anyone visiting St Petersburg, it's located in the heart of downtown and has something truly great to offer!

5 stars!!! I have worked in many sushi restaurants so I am quite picky. They have the perfect amount of rice, it's seasoned properly. Texture and temperature is spot on. The amount of fish you get and quality is amazing. I am also quite picky about drinks - I need real lime juice in my $12 marg and this place does exactly that! They  day don't make rookie mistakes like putting crushed ice in old fashioneds. This place should be 5 stars, not 4. Atmosphere is beautiful, if I lived here I would be a repeat customer once a week!

Does not follow covid guidelines, and not the best service. The food is just okay. It would of probably been better but it took over an hour for us to receive our food, even our coffee got cold and no one offered more while waiting. Super disappointed and will not go back. Lastly, not family friendly.

This place was perfect for our summer Saturday night!  We had our kiddos with us, so we grabbed a couple of tables on the patio (the inside is 21+). My kids made friends with some other kids, and had a blast with the jenga, cornhole and rings games while the adults sipped on beer and wine as we waited for our pizza.
The employees are all very welcoming, friendly, and helpful.  
We got the Smoking Chick and did a make your own for the kids. They were both delicious!
It was a great evening!  Highly recommended.
Orders pizza to go not like it use to be hardly any roping will not be going back stage was nice
Gambino's did a wonderful job on our wedding cake! Very affordable & easy to get in touch with. & our cake was delicious! Highly recommend!
I've had delivery twice and the wings are just absolutely awful. Fried pickles are decent but I will never order here again

Dropped in for my first time with my daughter and wife. They of course had failed to tell me they've been there a number of times without me. After having taste of four different rolls, I'm more than a little peeved at them for not telling me about this place before. 
The service was quick and friendly and the rolls came out quickly. The best part was the taste for the sushi and the sauces. Every one of them, was unique and delicious. Had the Dragon, Zodiac, Orange County and a Dynamite. This is now my favorite South Reno place for sushi. 
I'm yearning to go back and try out some of the others.

It's good for a quick bite, their tacos aren't to die for. I do appreciate the vegetarian taco options and all day breakfast taco options! Personally though, I would much rather make tacos at home, but if someone at work is ordering from tin roof, I'll eat it.

This used to be a pretty good restaurant, the food was not too far from what we make ourselves but it has become more Americanized. Not a judgement, just a warning to those with a more refined Italian palate. The sugar content was high, reminiscent of mild ketchup. The portions are definitely enormous if that's your choice.  One other problem was dirty cutlery..luckily I looked before using the fork: bits of food glued to it. It took 3 more sets before finding one that was usable.

The breakfast here is amazing and very good. What really made this experience great was the live music. The singer was very good and made me feel as if I were downtown Nashville. I will be back soon.  Thanks for a great experience.

I'll give two stars for the beef noodle soup.  Average.  You can get this dish anywhere very mediocre.  Same price as anywhere else.  Ok let's try their famous Tianjin pork bun.  It came out good size and hot that's a good thing.  It tasted bland.
Took another bite, I can tell it's not freshly made on the premise.  Frozen?  Your guess is good as mine.
The real reason I came here is for the Tianjin crepes.  It looked so good on looking at the pictures in Yelp.  It came out nice and hot.  Took a bite.
It's bland.  It's basically two pieces of fried dough wrapped with eggs as crepe.  What a ripoff!
No taste at all!!  Very disappointed.

I can't get to this place enough. It's a very hidden gem that you'd pass if not looking. They offer breakfast/brunch/lunch/dinner of a large variety. Each month they have a new pizza of the month which always offers a nice change of taste from your normal run of the mill pizza. I think they have arguably the best sandwiches in our area. Great place to hang out and watch a lightening game, enjoy a beer and would highly recommend the Nutella pizza for desert.  I think I get lucky at the times I visit because I see long wait times but the dozen times I've stopped in wasn't subjected to such and really hope that continues

Tried this hole in the wall Cuban place. Its next to a gas station and doesn't look like much from the outside. I had the Cuban sandwich and plantains. The plantains were amazing. The Cuban was really good, But pretty standard. Everything was super affordable for what you get. Look forward to going back.

Very fitting for the most culturally appropriated restaurant in Nashville to be in the most gentrified neighborhood. 

Food was solid but very small portions. Food comes out randomly and extremely unorganized. Not sure if they have a shortage of plates but they often put different orders on the same plate. 

Service was horrendous. No advice in navigating the menu and they never knew who ordered what when the food came. Also pretty sure we did not get everything we ordered. 

Expensive, solid food though, tough service. 
3 star!

Jan 8, 2021 5:00PM
Takeout order for 2
Fish sandwich - Excellent. Very nice serving of fish
Thick & tasty.....I loved it   Best I've had in St Louis to date. 
French fries - Excellent & tasty
Butterburger - Excellent

How this place is in business and Genghis didn't make it (I guess it was the location?) OR worse yet how this place has 3.5 stars on Yelp and Stir Crazy only has 3 is beyond me!

If what you seek is good Mongolian BBQ this place is...Not even close! 

The "Meats" Frozen clumps, many many veggie items completely empty, or a hodgepodge that appears neglected, and an extremely sloppy "sauce" bar....... Now we get to the "Grill Area" 
Sure the grill has to be "seasoned" but the whole area was a sloppy mess, with a floor with thick goo (Yeah Ive worked in a corp kitchen before and yes they get dirty and oh they can and should be cleaned!.... This one hasn't been cleaned in quite some time!) 
To be clear I've been to multiple places like this over the years and this is pretty much bottom of the barrel. 

What kept this place open is location, and the cool red neon lights on the outside because it sure isnt the food quality nor the Price because Stir Crazy is Far better and newsflash!..... About the same price (If you order the same thing) 

My suggestion Drive down the street to Stir Crazy!

Lesson learned: A First and Last time

My first time here, coming in for lunch with a coworker during a hard days work. Relaxing environment. Friendly faces, amazing personalities. 
Ordered the French Dip.  FANTASTIC. These guys hit it out of the park! Very flavourful, and the Au-jus sauce just made it all mouthwatering. Great place to bring the family, Military friendly. I absolutely loved it. Keep up the amazing work, McAlister's Team!

We were disappointed with our dinner this evening. The spanakopita was greasy and had minimal spinach filling. The waiter asked how everything was, I told him about the spanakopita, he said he was sorry to hear it, gave us rice pudding and left. The portion size of the  horiatiki salad was very small. We have eaten there before and gave it rave reviews.  Perhaps this was an off evening.  I do not think we will return.

Hattie throws down in the kitchen. We ordered takeout and YES MA'AM this place is delicious. If you're looking Southern Comfort Food, this is the place for you. 
We had the catfish and almost every side on the menu and everything was amazing. We ordered again 2 days later because the food is that good.
I highly recommend H & T's. Please support Black-owned and eat delicious food!

Well first of all the table we received was dirty sticky greasy pretty much and cleaned. A server came over to clean it basically just wiped it still remains sticky but thankfully when we slid in we were able to dry the seats off with our pants.
The salsa seem to be made from canned whole tomatoes ground up a few spices at it so it was rather runny flavorless soup. 
 Any Mexican restaurant that serves ground beef as an ingredient for a taco or burrito should be a clue that that restaurant is not Mexican rather gringo. Also it was rather disgusting that some of the meals were topped with a cheese sauce really. Furthermore they over salt the food. The next morning we bloated up like the Michelin tire man. 
Service was fair but overall you would have the same Mexican food at a cheaper price if you went across the street to Taco Bell. Bottom line this place is GHETTO.

I understand it's COVID but I live in LA last time I was in town was thanks giving I'm now back for Christmas and they still, after one month, are only accepting cash. How? Is the corporation not fixing your debit machines? Give me a solid explanation why "over a billion served" can fix a debit machine don't even get me started on the damn ice cream. You offer a celebrity meal that includes a milkshake that you can't even get. Tighten it up ffs. Nobody caries cash anymore and a month down for such a massive Corp is unfavthomable. That's like Amazon saying they'll only accept cash for over a month. McDonald's  ok males has been steadily declining on service for years now. Pull it together man.  Not the employees fault at all. The execs suck. Period.

Still the best breakfast in Clearwater! Since there's no outside dining they are now running all tables we'll probably switch to take out since it's such a popular breakfast spot! The cheese sticks in the danish basket are to die for!
My go-to noodle place! My favorite meat choices are the crispy pork and bbq pork. Broth is always flavorful. And I recommend changing your noodles to wheat noddles.

Did not have a good experience with them. They did not speak(say hello) or ask am I ready to order. Was in the front waiting  for a good 10 mins before someone took my order. Not a welcoming experience .I order over 50 dollars worth of food and NOTHING was good.

The food was great; however, the service was subpar. We arrived right at 5:30pm, the happy hour special ended at 6pm. Our server was nonexistent. After waiting for over 30 minutes to order, we had to ask another server. Once the bill arrived, I asked how come I didn't receive the happy hour price, he said it was because we ordered after 6pm. *insert eye roll emoji*. Also, we asked for four separate checks. He handed up all four checks- instead of handing them out individually. I don't need to know how much my friends spent on dinner.
Excellent ribs & brisket  fried Okra & Cole slaw was good too. Best Smoked meat so far that we have tried

Really a great new concept in eating out I imagine is going to catch on as it seems to have already done in Hawaii and Japan. Basically you can see all of the ingredients that will be in your bowl of food and you start with some noodles or Brown rice or white rice and add some protein foods and many other ingredients afterwards and it turns out wonderfully delicious.
Don't get the make at home stuff. Got sick from their lasagna and it was basically just mush. Hardly any noodle.
Really good vegan sushi options, the best I've found in the area. Staff has always been extremely nice.

Very disappointed with the quality of the food.  The Tom Yum Shrimp Soup had 6 overcooked really small shrimp, the Pork Pad Thai was just rice noodles and a few pieces of really tough pork and the Sticky Rice with Mango had mango that was turning dark and the rice was sticky like half-dried glue. We ordered spice level 3 (medium spicy) and it was really spicy. Not ordering from here again.

So happy to see such a variety of vegan options. The vegan bahn mi was so fresh and delicious along with the beet salad.  I also enjoyed a limosa. I don't know what took me so long to try it out, but I will definitely be back soon!!

We had tried this place in Atlanta and absolutely loved it, so we were really excited when we heard that they were opening in King of Prussia! A few weeks after they opened, we decided to stop by for dinner one evening and see how it stacked up versus the one we had loved so much in Atlanta.

Our experience here was really great overall, but the tacos weren't all quite to the same level as those we'd had in Atlanta. In particular, the fish taco in Atlanta absolutely blew my mind. Although the one here in KOP was a good fish taco, it was missing a little something that made the one in Atlanta just amazing. All the other tacos tasted great, though, including the duck and carnitas! We started our meal with a quesadilla, which was also wonderful!

In addition to the tacos, we also ordered one of the non-alcoholic drinks, the ginger grapefruit agua fresca. We had tried and enjoyed the other two in Atlanta, and we loved this one as well.

Even though I didn't love the fish taco as much as the one in Atlanta, I still enjoyed the tacos and would definitely go back!
Been eating here 20+ years..always good food, with usually enough for 2 or 3 meals. Good egg rolls, rangoons and garlic chicken.

Just excellent!  I had NY strip. Date had one of the chicken plates with a crusted cheese topping. She loved it. 

The prices are moderate for upscale dining and drinks so it's definitely going to be a regular spot.
My best friend makes the best enchiladas but she moved! This definitely is next best thing! So authentic!  So amazing  thanks guys!

I love this place. The customer service is excellent,  the food is always hot fresh, and very tasteful. The fish tacos are the bomb. The crawfish corn soup is wonderful. I have visited this establishment several times and they receive an A. I would highly recommend this restaurant.  5 star service definitely is here!

Went on a date with my girlfriend to eat here. If you like crowds this place will please you, for me not so much. Could barely walk in when we came in business was going good. Ambiance and decor was very very nice, dim lighting a nice place for a date or family dinner. I had reservations got in right away which was a plus. Although it seemed like we got jammed into a table. Waiters and bus boys running into each other every few seconds, and a tense staff due to the lack of space they have to work with. Food was good but not good for the price. Meals are small and over priced. Same goes for the desserts. Would I try this place again? Eh probably not, seems like a place I'd go once in a blue moon. Overall Decent place to eat, seems more for the locals.

The food here is always pretty great. Today we tried the Captain Crunch French toast and it was absolutely amazing. The servers are always very friendly as well. The only complaint that I do have is that the window open into the kitchen area may not be such a great idea when the cook has rubber gloves on and keeps picking his phone up and texting in between making peoples meals...all with the same pair of gloves the whole time we were there. Pretty gross and extremely unsanitary (the reason I removed one star).

We always enjoy going to Texas Roadhouse. The service is good and the steaks and other main dishes are delicious. The bread is awesome and my family likes all the sides. It is a great place to celebrate a birthday! Fun times for everyone!

Was excited to try this place after buying gift cards at Costco.  So we finally went on a late Saturday morning right before 11 a.m.  There were only 3 active tables when we got there, a nice outdoor seating area, but nobody was seated outside.  After being seated we sat for about 10 minutes before we saw a single server, saw three of them all at once but none of them came over to our table, by now a 4th table had been seated.  A waitress goes over to them and takes there order, again, we just sit. FINALLY our waitress comes over and asks us what we want to drink, well by this time we decided it was probably best to just order our food at the same time.  We sit another 15 minutes waiting for our drinks, are you kidding me?  So now we've been here 25 minutes just sitting....so we drink our coffee, we watch the table of 4 who came in after us...about 10 minutes later...here comes our waitress!  Yay!....with water?!  She asked us if we wanted water refills?  It's now been 40 minutes and my blood is boiling and my boyfriend was getting tense too....he finally asks where the food is and the waitress tells us it should be out soon, SHOULD BE OUT SOON?  Meanwhile table 4 is about halfway done eating.  We only ordered eggs Benedict, nothing earth shattering!  So we just left, starving, went to Wawa and ate Sizzlies....thanks AVENUE KITCHEN for a really shitty morning!

I/we are so glad that Casablanca's has reopened. Went there again last night with relatives from out of town. The food was terrific as always and the entertainment (belly dancer) was THE best we have seen there. 

During our last two visits we have learned that there vegetarian and gluten-free options available as well. 

August 2020 update. Menu has changed a bit but still very good. I reduced my rating not because of food but because the mask policy was not consistently followed. Some servers were good but a couple always had their nose out. Be warned.

Delicious! We had mussels, Caesar Salad and arugula salad.
& The service was awesome .

Such a fun place for tapas and drinks! We shared the patatas bravas, a charcuterie board, shishito peppers, and the croquettes. We loved everything except the charcuterie board, which we found underwhelming. 

The bourbon drink and wines were delicious. 

Overall, a great place to get together with girlfriends or for a date night!

I just love everything about Oxford Exchange, they have such a beautiful aesthetic and great food to match. OE is actually a culmination of great food, goods, a place to meet and socialize. 

The whipped feta is soooo good. You can always order more naan. The black bean burger was great but next time I would get different onions. The service was great. My only recommendation is if you are trying to go there on the weekend call ahead because there will be a significant wait! If you did end up waiting its okay because they have a great bookstore, shop....not to mention a champagne bar! 

Check it out, you wont regret it.

Came here simply to get a to-go salad so I didn't think I would have much of an impression one way or the other as far as service is concerned. Figured I would walk in to the bar, place my order, get my food, and leave. I ended up making a pretty custom salad just because of what I was feeling at the moment, and the guy who took my order (Ryan) was extremely accommodating, friendly, and over all made the little bit of time I was sitting here super easy and comfortable. He asked if I wanted anything to drink while I waited, if he could bring me bread or anything (both of which I declined) but you could tell he wanted to make my wait enjoyable. He was only covering bar for someone else for a brief period of time, but when the actual bartender (Lexi) came back and my food came out, she checked the box before giving it to me, noticed something missing after checking my receipt (when she didn't even take the order) and immediately said "hold on let me go back to the kitchen, they forgot something." The fact that my order was so off the wall honestly I'm not surprised something minor was missed by the kitchen (no biggie at all) and my entire over all wait time was short. The manager even came and apologized!! I never leave reviews but it's the little things that stand out to me and this place seems great, plus my salad was delicious!

New to Vietnamese food. Tried this based on positive reviews and location. There are about 60 meal variations. Got 15B and 19. Both were good. Will return soon to try more. Apparently can BYOB. $20 credit card minimum, tho 2 meals will cover. They dont bring you a bill. Get up and tell the cashier what table you were at when you're done. The condiments at the table are quite spicy.
We had Benny biscuit, Chronic bacon, man I got so full and it was the best. You will not be disappointed with anything you order here.
This is what my avocado toast $5 looked like. They should be embarrassed serving something like that, needless to say after 1 bite it was gross.

Holy crap this place lives up to the hype! I've been struggling to find a go-to pizza place in Indy and I finally found one after three years! The pizza had the perfect amount of toppings to crust/cheese/sauce ratio. We ordered The GP which was extremely unique but all came together very well. The spinach artichoke bread was also very unexpectedly good as I'm someone who doesn't enjoy spin dip at all. Lastly, the service was wonderful. Will definitely return soon. 

I recently dined in again and was so impressed. When the kitchen messed up our order, not only did they remake the sandwich, but they let us keep the original AND sent us home with one! Three sandwiches for the price of one! Definitely wasn't anything to complain about.

We came for the craft burgers! $11 for a burger, fries, and either 2 glasses of wine or beer (angry orchard cider included). So worth it! If you don't think you can drink two that's ok, it's just $9! If you don't drink, it's 50% for the burger and fries! Such a good deal! 

We figured it'd be busy because of the special tonight but got there around 7 and there was plenty of seating. 

Our server Charles was great, very attentive. 

We also got the espresso sundae which was a ton of ice cream. Enough for my husband, 2 year old, and I to share. Tip- the bottle of espresso liquid might be jammed so squeeze with caution or you'll go home wearing it like me, ha! 

All ages welcome and a small kids menu with 4 options is available.

This is not my first time here.  I used to love this place, I would stop there once a week or so and grab a Cuban sandwich, guava pastry and a cup of Cafe con Leche. My uncle has not been in Florida for 10 years so he wanted a Cuban sandwich . I  remembered this was a great place for a Cuban sandwich.  I took him here and had the absolute worst time. The lady that worked the counter was bossy,  the Cuban sandwich was absolutely horrible. 
 It was dry as a bone, no mayonnaise or mustard on the sandwich at all.  One chunky tomato that was on my sandwich was about an inch thick and it was the hard stem part. The green center from the stem. My uncle was totally disgusted with his sandwich. I could not finish mine, my wife was very unhappy with hers also. Regardless, we paid this meal of $30 and I'm going to tell you I think that that meal was about $29.95 overcharged.  To be completely honest again this was the worst experience I have ever had there and because of this experience I will never return.

I can definitely see what all the hype is about with the fried chicken here. I feel like I would have definitely enjoyed all the fried goodness even more if we'd visited Willie Mae's earlier in our stay..before we'd already eaten tons of greasy foods. 

We got to the restaurant before the doors had even opened and were the first ones in line. As soon as the doors opened, we were ushered in and seated quickly. Although the front of the restaurant looks small and unassuming, they actually have a large extension in the rear, although lighting isn't as great as the seats up front. Thankfully we got one of the front room slots! 

The menu is straight forward with the option for different types of meat and different sides. My friends and I all got the fried chicken (dark meat, duh) but with different sides so we could try a little bit of everything. The fried okra was yummy, but a little too heavy for me. I actually preferred my friend's green beans more. All in all, I can definitely see why Willie Mae's chicken is top in the nation. The batter is perfectly crispy but the meat so tender and so moist. I really don't know how they do it...but I wish I could be let in on that secret! 

Service was super friendly in the typical southern way. We really enjoyed our experience there and have been recommending this as a must-see stop on trips to NOLA!

Not sure what all the ranting & raving is about this place. Had a co-worker mention it, so it was our first time, but I don't think my husband & I will be back. I ordered the roast beef w/ fries; He ordered the southern fried steak. My fries were room temp, and hard because of it. The roast beef was decent, but nothing amazing. Husband said the same about his- it was okay but nothing great. Said he could it make it at the house. Again- not terrible but during dinner we both had wished we had chosen somewhere else. I will say they do have lots to choose from on the menu, which is nice, but I truly wonder how much of it is homemade/made in house and not pre-packaged and frozen. Beyond the food, we were told a 20 minute wait and waited 40. Didn't realize the served a basket of bread until our waitress asked us if we wanted it now or with our food. I feel as if this should automatically be brought out, otherwise whats the point of a bread basket? I don't want bread with my main meal. After seeing it on anothers table, I could care less. Its sliced white bread with prepackaged butter. What the? Why even? A tad irrelevant but I do feel atmosphere matters, and the music selection was so awful. Eminem, bebe rexha, and halsey. I imagine the staff makes the playlist, if I had to guess. Not sure how the persistent & higher percentage of the older crowd we saw there stands it. The outdoor seating is nice I will say but we didn't choose it because husband was getting bit up as we were wai

This place has been one of my favorite spots to visit over there years.  I stopped in yesterday for the first time in a couple years.  It's good for lunch or a later dinner.  The food is always good and fresh and the people are nice.  You'll see all kind of people in here because of the location and the a good thing.  The food has been delicious every single time.
Good drunk food drive-thru; get your dd to stop here for breakfast burritos before you head home. 24/7

Vale is a super convenient place for me to pick up lunch--I work in the Suntrust building. My observations:

1. Very small portions for high prices
2. Most things I've tried are bland
3. The ordering system is confusing. I think you order poke and açaí bowls on the side and bowls at the back.
4. If you come at lunch time, the seating situation can be very uncomfortable. 

Do yourself a favor and get a flavorful, fresh, well-portioned lunch just two or three blocks away at SoFresh.

Went here for a bite at 9pm on a Wednesday. We walked in and the was no direction so after standing around we just picked a booth and sat down. The servers cold have been more attentive but this was great diner food. Had the blt and the turkey club. Bread was fresh, fries were good. Nice portions and delicious bacon. Would recommend! 

They have Plexi partitions between booths. Their cleaning was standard. I saw them cleaning the floor more than the tables but they were wiped down. 

Spent $23 on two sandwiches (with fries) and a soda. 

I wish we lived closer as I honestly think we would frequent more often.

We ordered delivery (COVID19) and were not disappointed. Ordering online was easy. Our food came about 20 mins earlier than we requested it even though requesting a certain time when we delivered so I missed the delivery man's call. However, the delivery service was great, he called multiple times and left a voicemail. He responded readily when I called back and the food arrived promptly. We had two empanadas which were fantastic (flaky crust despite coming via delivery and really good fillings). I got the ribeye and my wife the steak Milanese. Her steak was great. Breading was not soggy and was flavorful. The ribeye was perfectly cooked as I requested and fantastic. It came with a chimicurri side which I used sparingly but it didn't need it. 

Overall, we really enjoyed it. I can't wait to go in person when businesses are safe to re-open and try the cocktails and wine and ambience.

I have lived in Tampa for over 35 years, and I've always heard good things about Iavarone's. My wife and I recently stopped by for a lunch. This was the first time either of us ever been here. Everything was very nice the service was polite correct and the meal was tasty. 
We decided to come back and try the dinner. 
We started out by ordering two samples of wine where we found one that was very tasty and decided to order a full serving .  When that was brought to us my glass looked like it hadn't been washed in a month.  I had to send that back to get another glass of the same wine which thankfully was cleaned. No extra or apology given.
We ordered the Chateaubriand for two, medium rare. What we received was a piece of meat that was totally well done except for about a quarter size piece in the middle that was rare. It was disgusting, replete with a sour tasting sauce.
We requested a replacement which they did provide, but the taste was something I would imagine to be from an animal headed to the glue factory, and not a Prime, or even Choice steak. Same sour sauce.
I had always heard good things about this restaurant, and that it was comparable to Berns in quality.  This is was not even close. If I brought someone here on a special occasion I would have been embarrassed. If I were the owner of this establishment I would be embarrassed to serve this kind of food at those prices, along with a filthy wine glass, and expect people to not complain about this low grade food and se

Terrific. Prompt phone ordering, on time delivery and delicious pizza.
However...ordered wings. Terrible!  Very tough and dry. Obviously had been pre-cooked as they arrived 30 minutes after phone ordering.  Didn't come close to the hype on the phone. 
Very disappointed since pizza is so good. 
Oh well. Now I know.

Just order take out last night. I have eaten in dining many times I order spaghetti  meatballs  and  my wife order spaghetti and squid. Both of our pasta was so overcooked it turn into mushy ball of starch.  It must of been sitting in the potforever  the cook thought what a great idea to get rid of for take out and gave double amount. When you pay for a meal and it's not even edible what a wasTe of money you must be paying your cook  very little because they really do not know how  to cook We not coming back too this restaurant

I usually order from here on a weekly basis. The app chose my work address instead of my home. After waiting over an hour and calling they agreed to deliver to the correct address. Someone put the Rangoon in the microwave and they sent me a melted plastic sauce container and tepid sushi. We had to throw the whole thiNg away.  I would have rather paid again and received the proper quality product than reheated gross product. Never again.

There are not many good sushi restaurants available. We previously used another local restaurant until they changed prices and portions without reflecting it on their menu. Anyhow, this sushi was affordable (still running their grand opening special pricing) and DELICIOUS. So fresh and so appetizing, we got takeout and were pleasantly surprised by the entire experience from ordering online to bringing it home, easy as pie. I cannot say enough but I will be going back one million more times ! Thank you Sushi X for opening here!
Alicia took care of us for my friends birthday lunch! She suggested the passion fruit mimosa! I was skeptical but it was actually good. To be honest here for the cheesecake.

I really hate to write this because I've grown up going to Anna's. So I went this morning and got baked goods and a breakfast burrito. 
The baked goods were great!
However their burritos were less than good. I would say it was edible. however the potatoes were raw still. And I was informed by staff I couldn't get the burrito without eggs because they make it in one huge batch in the morning. 

I'll still go there for donuts and coffee but I won't be trying their hot breakfast items again.

I was super excited to go back here since the shutdown. Boy was I disappointed. The bartender whom we ordered our food from was really friendly and nice. The food runner who brought our food to us was just down right rude. I will not be coming back. She literally threw out utensils down on the table when we asked for some. I know service is going downhill everywhere but her manners where something else. Went to get a game card. Standing in line on the required box per instructions. Game attendant kept chatting with his friend and would not even wait on us until we asked if he was working or should we call for someone else. Will not be going back.
went for lunch with friend.  i enjoyed it...we weren't in rush, so it was nice.  enjoyed my seafood platter. friend had seafood linguine which looked really yummy.  i would go back.

This place used to be my go to for office pizza parties, and for a good take out option on my way home from work.  No longer, after a horrible experience with a poorly made (very sloppy, even the guy at the counter felt bad to give it to me) pizza a few weeks ago I was given a store credit for a future purchase.  I used that credit today to order a similar pizza,the agent on the phone even asked if i wanted the same pizza as my previous order.  However when I went to pick up this pizza it was a completely different order.  I probably should have checked before leaving,

A hole in the wall, diner style breakfast. Our server, not sure if she is the owner, was hilarious! On her recommendation, the home fries, extra crispy were perfect. My Denver omelet was good. And the husband and son said the bacon was perfect! Pancakes are plate sized! We enjoyed this breakfast more than the one for twice as much at our hotel!!!

I am so disappointed in this restaurant.  I keep going with my friends and family, hoping it will get better.  But it never does.  We just had lunch there and the fresh fruit and the avocado were not ripe. No one could eat the potatoes on the side. My mother's muffin was inedible. I left feeling sick, despite the kind waitress's attempts to fix things. Seriously, I have had the worst restaurant food of my life at the Inn repeatedly.  Yet I keep going, hoping it will get better. Why can't they get wonderful chefs that make delicious food?  Why is that not happening? The place was practically empty--doesn't the manager wonder why and want to make improvements?  It's such a lovely space and environment.  Why is no one doing anything to improve the food? And then they have the audacity to charge these expensive prices? Our community wants to support you but you make it so difficult.

I honestly have no idea how this place got so many good ratings. I ate there during Mardi Gras and it was so gross. I had the shrimp and grits and my boyfriend had some duck pasta. The grits  weren't smooth which is typical of grits at restaurants, but there was no seasoning. There was some andouille in it and it was so bland. 

As for my boyfriend's pasta it was also bland there was no sauce whatsoever just wet pieces of duck, macaroni noodles, and peas. 

Now this may have been a result of Mardi Gras, not sure. It wasn't packed at all though which is why we went, wish we wouldn't have though. The service was great though! Attentive waitress and she was really sweet.

What a great find! From the second we walked in everything was great, friendly staff and nice menu with specials. Enjoyed the complimentary snack and then shared a yummy meatball and Caesar. Tuna steak cooked well and paired with the right veggies. Delicious!

I'm so happy I found this place when visiting Santa Barbara! The store was beautiful and caught our eye walking down State Street. We ordered baklava, Turkish delights, and Turkish coffee and it was all so good! I never thought I was a baklava person but Lokum converted me - it was amazing! The staff was super friendly and helpful in helping us decide what to order. We ended up going back each day of our trip. Highly recommend!

Regarding delivery,

I placed my order on their website, which has the option for delivery, around 10:15 today. When I hadn't heard anything by 11:10 or so I called to ask. The girl who picked up said the food was ready and she didn't know why it was still in the restaurant and she was going to figure out who would be doing delivery. Received a call back 5 minutes later only for her to tell me her manager said the delivery driver was out for 1 month and I would need to come to get it or he could offer a refund. 

They've done this to me once before, months ago when I yet again ordered delivery from their online site. They used the same excuse. I guess I didn't learn. 

What made me so upset was the fact if I had not called, the food was goIng to keep sitting there....and it wasn't until I took the initiative to call that they informed me they didn't have a driver, OVER AN HOUR after I placed the order. If you're running a business, especially during times when individuals are trying their best to socially distance, you should keep your website updated if you have no delivery option. And also improve in your customer communication! 

This experience left a sour taste in my mouth and makes me never want to come back to dine in or take out.

Have they stopped boiling their bagels? The crust just wasn't what I remember. The dense, soft interior was there, but the bagel tasted more like a bread roll in the shape of a bagel. On the positive side, they had pumpernickel and salt bagels. We were there to late to snag some rye bagels.

Checking back in after a few years! During this quarantine we've decided to eat out with takeout at many local places! And this place was surely on my list to start.

They emailed their email list saying that they were still open, so that was a great way to begin the process. We placed our order and had it on the table within an hour. They were even offering free bacon at one point!

This place is a cut above the rest when it comes to a butcher shop around here. We really only have local supermarkets and maybe one or two meat shops. One of which, is the Amish market which is just a very distracting yummy place to go in general and also closed down during the quarantine.

David and sons did not disappoint and everyone loved their meals! The eggroll is such a great and delicious combination of flavors. Highly recommended! And the butter that they put on their generous serving of corn bread is so good! I got the brisket sandwich and it was pure perfection. They load the meat on there! It's so so yummy!!!


Thank you for feeding me during the quarantine!

I stumbled upon The Cook Out and I was pleasantly surprised! The best part of the experience was their fantastic selection of shake flavors.  I had a blueberry shake that was one of the best I have had in a hellava long time!

This place is AMAZING. After a long night on Bourbon Street (first time), we stopped here for a slice. I had the Chicken Bacon Krunch slice and despite it being a little expensive, it was worth every damn penny! So good. We looked over at the other people making the pizza and they smiled and told us it was made with love. Alisha & Travia were so positive and awesome and when we asked for another pizza (full pizza this time), they didn't make us wait in the long line and helped us right there. Loved their attitudes and pizza making skills! If you're in NOLA and need some late night food, this is the place!

We had an urge for a pita and this little place delivered.  We both had the chicken pita which were excellent.  The fries were just average and very dark like the oil needed to be changed.  The Greek potatoes were good, better than the fries.  The service was excellent as they accidentally gave me fries instead of my greek potatoes and when I mentioned it they apologized and brought the potatoes.

I ordered a King Cake through Goldbelly from Maurice's for my birthday that fell on Mardi Gras/Fat Tuesday. The cake remained wrapped up in my air conditioned kitchen for 3 days and when I opened it there was mold spots all over the top.
I asked Goldbelly for a replacement or a refund but they refused my request. They would not even give me a discount towards a new purchase.
So I had to throw my $55 King Cake in the trash.
Expensive lesson learned.
I gave 2 stars because the cake and the decoration kit looked like it would have been nice.

Best meal we've had in Tampa! We have been here for a year and tried several restaurants in the Tampa area. On Swann has greats atmosphere, amazing food, great service, and the Hyde Park neighborhood is awesome. Loves all of it.

I've been trying to describe how much I love this little restaurant.
Noodles...OMG, NOODLES!
Springy, light chew, LOTS of them!
Broth...thick, generous, depth, complex, fragrant.
Lobster balls...GET THEM! Huge lobster flavor and the seasoning they top them with is lightly spicy and adds to the their flavor.
One experience to note...
There was an older couple sitting next to me who shared that this was their first time eating here. They ordered a dish without reading the description and expressed to me their disappointment that there wasn't any broth with their noodles.
Not every dish that Juan Sichwan serves is a soup. The owners are extremely kind and helpful. Please feel comfortable and ask questions.

First time here and absolutely loved it! Such an unexpected cute atmosphere. The chips were amazing. We enjoyed all the food we ordered from the steak burrito to the lamb to the quesadilla to the salads. The side of corn with queso was amazing. Will definitely be back.

The extra star is for the fun doormen and awesome patrons... Otherwise one star suits it well. When you walk past it's inviting! Decent music and a fun crowd, but my issue. Main. Huge. Issue. Was one of the bartenders. We paid for our drinks, tipped well over 20%, and I thought all was good. But when my sister wanted another drink... The bartender blatantly ignored my sister. Why? It was not busy enough to skip over people...on a Tuesday. I threw a fit and asked one of the doormen to check the bartender. His response? "'Must be tip related" Well. I work in service too. I know the drill. But if you're going to ignore a guest, ask the people RIGHT next to them if they're okay and be a queen about not getting the amount you wished for well..... you probably shouldn't work in service! Other than that and the mega dirty, bug infested courtyard, it was a fun portion of the night pre-bartender hissy fit. Good last resort when your night is winding down!

I love mock meat - well, most times, that is. 

I love mock meat that doesn't market itself that way, you know? For instance, as a vegetarian, I really don't want a substitute that tastes like meat- that's not what I'm going for. I want something with texture, a unique flavor, and the potential to let me understand and taste a dish I otherwise would have been kept in thee dark about.

When I visited Philadelphia, I was pleasantly overwhelmed by their menu, mostly because the Midwest has almost nothing like it. (Actually, nothing like it). I was more overwhelmed by the fact that we, a rather non-adventurous Indian family, could all find things we enjoyed and would happily eat again.

The jerk caesar is exactly what you'd want and expect out of caesar salad. What thrilled me was the fact that THIS chicken caesar, I could actually eat! 

HipCityVeg is a great chain and conceptually, deserves a high level of praise. Perhaps American cuisine has omnivorous hope after all.
The coffee here was terrific, very flavorful but not bitter. Very friendly staff and fun ambiance.

This was our first trip to NOLA and I was looking forward to the food.  Red Fish Grill did not disappoint. We stopped in to grab a bite and get a brief break from Bourbon Street.  I would highly recommend the Alligator Boudin Balls. They had great flavor, a golden exterior that added texture and the pepper jelly had enough heat to bring in the right amount of kick.

Outstanding, awesome place. The food is great. The portion is perfect and especially the flavors wow. Everything was cooked just right. If I lived in Tucson I would come here all the time. Next time I come through here I will most definitely stop by again. Highly recommend this restaurant.

It's simple food here folks. 
Burrito is mostly meat, rice, and little bit of vegetable all wrapped into deliciousness. 
I got the spicy pork and I have to say taste is 5/5
Price is 4/5
It's a bit expensive when you compare to other burrito places ...but the portion is bigger. Like BIG 

Also waffle&gogi (meat) - what a great combination 
Highly recommend this dish- it sounds odd but the queso works wonderfully with bulgogi and Seoul Sauce. 

I would say don't get the chicken because I'm not sure if that's really "Korean". It's more like teriyaki. 

Still I give this place an overall of 5/5 because of its consistent goodness and the delicious taste and portions. 

I would definitely come back again when I visit St. Louis
Very rude and don't seem to care if you never come back. Gave the benefit of the doubt but have had more than one bad experience here.

Was hungry and driving by.  When I saw the prices I almost walked out but the other person was really hungry.  The food is ok but not at all worth the price.  I don't know how this place stays in business since there are so many options that are just as good but cheaper.  I will never come back here.

We stopped for a nice meal and were treated to wonderful service, delicious food, and amazing wait staff. Even the manager, Brandon, was all hands on deck. He was serving food, clearing tables, moving furniture, and ensuring guest satisfaction. Our waiter, Justin, was spot on. He was diligent in watching our table, had refills on our drinks before we would ask, catered to us, and made us feel at home. The food was absolutely delicious. We were in during the lunch rush, and we're still had great service that was quick and accurate. We were able to hear the kitchen staff communicate with the expo and the wait staff, they were fabulous. We will definitely be back. 
Thank you, Grill Smith, for a terrific lunch. 
Ivan and Mary Cuesta
the food is ok, considering it's a fast food place. but mark my words, this company supports coversion camps

It's a dive, but this is the best pizza in town, hands down. I'm there once a week. Some people complain about the indifferent service and the fact that there are cleaner bathrooms in a New York subway station. Who cares- Pizza talks, baby
Love the food and every time I come back from out of town I get the same amazing quality I've the past 6 years.  Highly recommend!
